channel.title: Early Trends
channel.description: New early-trend product picks from Early Trends. Free RSS; no account required.

item.title: Pop Mart Twinkle Twinkle
item.description: Pop Mart’s Twinkle Twinkle plush pendants: reported minute-long sell-outs and resale above retail in China, and a US series that launched on 1 October 2026. Identified on October 28, 2026 (2026-10-28). Stage at identification: Early in the West.

item.title: Kitsch zig-zag headbands
item.description: Kitsch zig-zag headbands, about $10 for a 2-pack: a cited Pinterest search lift, about 4,600 TikTok posts, and sightings on Gigi Hadid and Hailey Bieber. Identified on October 28, 2026 (2026-10-28). Stage at identification: Early.

item.title: Vaseline Originals Brow Tamer Jelly
item.description: Vaseline Originals Brow Tamer Jelly and All-In-One Primer & Highlighter: TikTok Shop sell-outs in Thailand, a US launch still planned, seeded by 2008 creator hacks. Identified on October 28, 2026 (2026-10-28). Stage at identification: Very early.

item.title: Hojicha lattes
item.description: Hojicha lattes: searches cited up 173%, a March 2026 search high, and new US menus at The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf and Black Sheep Coffee. Identified on October 28, 2026 (2026-10-28). Stage at identification: Early–mid.

item.title: The Unselected Journals of Emma M. Lion
item.description: Beth Brower’s Emma M. Lion journals: Bloomsbury bought volumes 1–8 after self-publishing, and signed volume 9. A BookTok claim from a shop blog is marked as a weak signal. Identified on October 28, 2026 (2026-10-28). Stage at identification: Early.

item.title: FiiO DM13 portable CD player
item.description: The FiiO DM13 is a portable CD player in a wider wave of young people buying CD players again. Category demand is cited; a sell-out of this model is not. Identified on October 28, 2026 (2026-10-28). Stage at identification: Early.

item.title: Rachel Zoe marble mushroom lamp
item.description: The Rachel Zoe marble mushroom lamp, about $80 at HomeGoods: viral in November 2025, and reported back on shelves in October 2026. Identified on October 28, 2026 (2026-10-28). Stage at identification: Mid.

item.title: PUMA Deviate Nitro Elite 4 HYROX
item.description: PUMA’s Deviate Nitro Elite 4 HYROX shoe, alongside a cited HYROX search boom and a sell-out reported in Korea. Not a global sales figure. Identified on October 28, 2026 (2026-10-28). Stage at identification: Mid.

item.title: BubblePlush Yoga Ball Buddies
item.description: hand2mind’s BubblePlush Yoga Ball Buddies: a TikTok Shop sell-out, a Meijer rollout, three new characters, and a plain Amazon listing. Identified on October 28, 2026 (2026-10-28). Stage at identification: Early.

item.title: Brick phone blocker
item.description: The Brick phone blocker, about $59, in a reported phone-free wave. A habit tool only: no medical claims and no treatment promises. Identified on October 28, 2026 (2026-10-28). Stage at identification: Mid.

item.title: Woof Pupsicle
item.description: The Woof Pupsicle and its refills: cited search lifts in pet trends, a TikTok Shop reviews page, and the brand’s own product page. No sell-out figure. Identified on October 28, 2026 (2026-10-28). Stage at identification: Mid.

item.title: Sabre Paris Bistrot flatware
item.description: Sabre Paris Bistrot flatware: cited search interest plus lookalikes in the design press. No unit-sales figure. Identified on October 28, 2026 (2026-10-28). Stage at identification: Mid.
